jobs.description:
As a Group Food Safety & Quality Assurance (FSQA) Audit & Certification Assistant, you will provide administrative, analytical, and reporting support for food safety audits and certification programs across our international production sites.
 
 

• Coordinate food safety, sustainability, religious, ethical, and customer-specific certification schemes across the Group. 

• Monitor certification statuses, audit schedules, renewal timelines, and maintain accurate compliance records and databases. 

• Support the planning, administration, documentation, and follow-up of internal and external audits across production sites. 

• Develop and maintain KPI dashboards, reporting tools, and perform trend analyses to support data-driven decision-making. 

• Track audit findings and corrective actions, ensuring timely follow-up and closure. 

• Provide administrative and analytical support for continuous improvement projects, annual program reviews, and FSQA initiatives. 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• A Bachelor's degree in a food-related or data-analytical field. 

• Experience in an administrative or support role within a technical, quality, or food industry environment. 

• Strong reporting and data management skills, with advanced knowledge of MS Office applications. 

• Experience with databases, KPI reporting, dashboards, and data visualization tools; knowledge of auditing and certification schemes is a strong asset. 

• Professional proficiency in English, knowledge of Dutch and/or French is a plus. 

• A detail-oriented, analytical, and structured mindset, combined with flexibility, independence, and a positive attitude.

As an Inventory Planner Natural Foods, you play a key role in ensuring the right stock is available at the right time. By working closely with production, suppliers, and sales, you help achieve an optimal balance between availability and costs. With your proactive approach, you contribute to a smooth supply chain and sustainable results.
 

Job description
 
 

• Managing and creating purchase orders for production plants, co‑manufacturers, and suppliers based on aligned planning with the demand planning teams. 

• Monitoring and analysing inventory levels to ensure optimal availability and service levels. 

• Proactively communicating about supply and expiry risks and contributing to the implementation of robust inventory management processes and best practices. 

• Aligning with internal production and supply chain teams to follow up on production plans and to identify and mitigate potential supply risks in a timely manner. 

• Monitoring production and transportation flows and ensuring accurate and up‑to‑date data in SAP. 

• Continuously improving and further automating the replenishment process, including optimisation of planning parameters. 

Profile
 

To be able to achieve the above and be successful in this role we believe you need to have:
 
 

• You hold a bachelor’s degree in a business‑related field. 

• You have at least one to two years of experience in supply chain planning, preferably in an FMCG or retail environment, and are familiar with working in a logistics‑ or transport‑oriented customer service setting; knowledge of SAP is a plus. 

• You have strong verbal and written communication skills in English and collaborate smoothly with various internal departments. 

• You work independently and proactively, with a strong attention to detail and a high level of accuracy. 

• You are able to set priorities and work efficiently in a fast‑paced, dynamic environment.

Responsibilities

• Evaluate backend and endpoint infrastructure to define upgrades, changes, and expansion proposals.
• Conduct feasibility studies and evaluate hardware and software solutions to meet organizational needs.
• Develop technical designs in alignment with specific architectural requirements and implement system improvements.
• Provide high-level support and maintenance for the IT infrastructure following ITIL methodologies.
• Deliver technical advice and information to internal and external stakeholders regarding the technology stack.
• Maintain technical documentation and actively share expertise within the engineering team.

Requirements

• You possess 8+ years of experience in system engineering within large-scale environments of at least 100,000 endpoints.
• You have expert knowledge of Intune, including MDM, MAM, BYOD, Enterprise Mobility + Security, and Conditional Access Policies.
• You bring advanced expertise in System Center Configuration Manager (SCCM), focusing on distribution groups, task sequences, and software management.
• You have in-depth experience with Active Directory, LDAP, GPO, and domain management.
• You possess deep expertise in infrastructure stacks for Windows, MacOS, Linux, Android, and iOS.
• You have 5+ years of experience with PowerShell and VBScript for infrastructure automation.
• You bring broad knowledge of Azure, including license assignment and dynamic groups, alongside Office 365 and Windows Defender.
• You possess a solid understanding of networking protocols such as TCP/IP, DNS, DHCP, and VLAN.
• You’re able to interact effectively with diverse technical and business stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch or French with a very good level of English.
Nice to Haves

• Certifications in MCSA, MCSE, or MCSD.
• Experience with ServiceNow or PM² methodology.
• Knowledge of PatchMyPC or 3rd party MDM solutions like Knox or KAI.

FLYINGGROUP, one of Europe’s leading business jet operators, has an open position for a Flight Care Agent at the main office in Antwerp.

The Flight Care Agent is a member of the Operational Control Centre Team. The main OCC activities are the planning and preparation of FLYINGGROUP’s flights. The OCC supports our global operations and our business is rapidly growing. We are expanding our worldwide activity and are looking for a Flight Care Agent.

Your goal

You will be joining our OCC Flight Care Department which always strives to make the most informed decisions and provide top-quality service to our clients, making our company stand out from the rest.

Your duties and responsibilities

The planning and preparation of all FLYINGGROUP’s flights, including VIP catering arrangements, Customer transportation, keeping PAX details and formalities up to date and performing detailed feasibility checks, taking appropriate action to tackle any irregularity. You provide good support to the Senior Flight Care Agent in completing other tasks as assigned.

Your profile

• The Flight Care Agent is highly Customer minded and pays full attention to the particulars of each Customer.
• Good communication skills, meaning an excellent (spoken and written) knowledge of Dutch and English and good knowledge of French.
• You are well organized, stress-resistant, and able to multitask while maintaining a calm composure and working with continuously changing flight schedules.
• You are highly self-motivated with a proactive approach and like to work in a team.
• You have good geographical knowledge.
• You have good computer knowledge: Word, Excel.
• Experience in aviation is a must, experience in business aviation is a plus
• Have a good base of aviation terminology and IATA and ICAO codes.
• You are flexible, willing to work in shifts and during weekends.
• Local resident is preferable.
Offer

We offer a full-time position with a salary matching your qualifications. The work schedule is flexible in shifts and will include weekend shifts. Training "in-house".

Take the lead in operations at Skechers and guide your teams toward excellence in a fully automated and fast-growing environment!

Skechers USA is a global leader in lifestyle and performance footwear, generating $9 billion in annual revenue. The company designs, develops, and markets over 3,000 styles for men, women, and children.

Why join Skechers?

• A fast-growing international company
• A warm, dynamic, and tech-forward work environment
• A culture that embraces diversity and inclusion
• A competitive salary package
• The extra perk? An on-site gym with a personal coach
To strengthen its operational team, our client Skechers is currently looking for an Operations Manager for its site in Herstal.

 

 

Jobomschrijving

As an Operations Manager at Skechers, you report directly to the Director of Operations and independently manage several departments.

Your key responsibilities include:

• Planning, organizing, and supervising daily operations to meet short- and long-term goals, while ensuring budget, deadlines, and safety standards are met in an automated environment.
• Promoting and maintaining a strong safety culture.
• Developing strategic business plans for the short, medium, and long term for your departments.
• Taking necessary actions to achieve performance objectives by defining and monitoring team KPIs, while effectively managing operational costs.
• Leading, coaching, evaluating, and developing your teams (approx. 150 people) in collaboration with Team Leaders and Leads. Communication is central to your role—both with your teams and social partners.
• Managing and optimizing automated processes with a continuous improvement mindset.
This role requires adaptability, versatility, and a proactive approach to overcoming daily challenges and driving operational excellence.

Education and technical skills:

• Minimum 3 years of proven experience in a similar role within an automated/production environment.
• Proficiency in WMS, WCS, and AS400 systems.
• Solid knowledge of Microsoft Office tools (Excel, Word, Outlook).
• Strong working knowledge of English.
Your personality and soft skills:

• Leadership – You are a driver of change and adapt easily to a constantly evolving environment.
• Communication – You adjust your communication to suit your audience and actively listen.
• Customer & results orientation – You go the extra mile to ensure customer satisfaction.
• Stress management – You remain positive and composed when facing day-to-day challenges.
• Conflict resolution & negotiation – You are assertive and diplomatic when managing tensions.
• Attention to detail – You are uncompromising when it comes to safety and adherence to procedures and workplace rules.

Datashift, a rapidly expanding team dedicated to providing data-driven solutions for business challenges, is seeking a talented Analytics Engineer to join us.

 
Your responsibilities 
In this role, you will play a crucial part in translating client needs into sustainable data solutions, encompassing ETL processes, Infrastructure as Code, interfaces, and pipelines.

• Designing data solutions, balancing cost and maintainability.
• Collaborating with Data Scientists, BI specialists, and Business Consultants to deliver value.
• Staying abreast of the latest developments in data technology and actively sharing knowledge with colleagues.
• Monitoring the quality and stability of data solutions.
• Mentoring and coaching other Analyticals Engineer. 
Your qualifications
 

Do you have 4 to 6 years of experience, including at least 2 years in a cloud environment? Do you possess a passion for approaching projects from an end-to-end data perspective? We are delighted to receive your personal application and we’ll contact you for an interview and a (virtual) cup of coffee.

 

• You can adeptly apply diverse data modeling styles and collaborate with our customers to develop the optimal data model for their needs.
• You grasp data structures & formats and are familiar with popular (cloud) data warehouses.
• You navigate DBT with expertise, effortlessly crafting a new project, playing with all the DBT-blocks to build a castle from the ground up.
• Deep knowledge of SQL;
• You have a proven track record of effortlessly incorporating DevOps best practices such as CI/CD, IaC, and unit testing. CI/CD, which may sound like a secret code, is a realm you navigate with ease. You not only grasp its steps but can also articulate why it's indispensable for any data project. Moreover, you possess the skills to autonomously set it up.
• You approach challenges with an analytical and solution-oriented mindset, and you're well-acquainted with agile methodologies and collaborative teamwork.
• Experience with Docker and PySpark is a plus;
• Experience with dataframe API’s in Python (Panda’s, Polars, ...);
• Fluent in Dutch and/or French and English.

Aluvision is a fast-growing international company and a market leader in innovative modular exhibition systems for exhibits & events, retail, and interior design. Our high-quality, sustainable solutions are trusted by global brands and partners to create impactful and flexible environments.
 

To support our continued growth, we are expanding our presence in Italy and are looking for a driven 
Sales Manager Italy to accelerate our commercial success in this key market.
 

As Sales Manager Italy, you grow our customer portfolio through active prospecting and lasting partnerships. You combine commercial drive with technical understanding to advise customers. You report directly to the Sales Director.

 

•  

A professional sales experience of minimum 5 years
  

•  

Experience in B2B sales, business development, field sales or account management, with success in acquiring new customers.
  

•  

A proactive hunter mentality, strong communication and negotiation skills, and an independent, structured approach.
  

•  

Technical understanding and solution-oriented selling skills; experience in exhibitions, events or display systems is a plus.
  

•  

Fluent Italian, a good command of English, and commercial or technical education or equivalent experience.
  

•  

Willingness to travel across Italy for approximately 60% of your working time.

jobs.occupation: Junior Data Engineer – Commercial & Support Functions
jobs.description:
• You support the design, development, testing, and documentation of ETL/ELT data pipelines that transform operational data into reliable datasets for BI, analytics, machine learning, and AI. 
• You contribute to the integration of data from commercial & support fonctions systems such as ERP, CRM, marketingplatformen, HR, and other operational applications. 
• You help build data products and semantic models covering topics such as sales performance, marketing effectiveness, financial reporting and HR analytics. 
• You perform data quality checks, investigate data issues, and contribute to maintaining accurate documentation, monitoring, and data lineage. 
• You learn and apply modern data engineering practices, including version control, testing, CI/CD, and DataOps. 
• You work in an agile environment alongside data analysts, data scientists, IT colleagues, and business stakeholders, gradually developing into a well-rounded data professional.  
You report directly to the Data & Analytics Platform Architect.

 
• You hold a Master's degree in IT, Data, Engineering, or a related field. 
• You have gained relevant experience through internships, academic projects, or an initial professional experience. 
• You have a solid foundation in SQL and Python and are eager to further develop your expertise in modern cloud data platforms such as Azure and Databricks. 
• You are interested in data modelling, ETL/ELT processes, data warehousing, lakehouse architectures, testing, and documentation. Experience with dbt or similar frameworks is considered a plus. 
• You are analytical, detail-oriented, and eager to learn. You enjoy understanding how business processes work and how high-quality data supports better decision-making. 
• You are comfortable using AI tools to work more efficiently, accelerate learning, and support innovative solutions. 
• You communicate fluently in English and enjoy collaborating with both technical teams and business stakeholders. Knowledge of Dutch a plus.

Your responsibilities as a Financial Controller :

• Coordinate the monthly closing process and ensure accurate, complete, and reliable financial reporting.
• Support daily finance operations and deliver timely management reporting through Power BI.
• Prepare budgets and forecasts while analysing margins, variances, and financial performance.
• Partner with Business Units to provide financial insights and support business reviews.
• Ensure compliance with financial regulations and maintain high accounting standards.
• Implement and monitor internal controls to minimise financial risks and improve data quality.
• Coordinate external audits and assist with annual accounts and corporate tax filings.
• Contribute to finance digitalisation projects and continuously improve financial processes.
• Report directly to the Finance Manager.
 

 

About you :

• You hold a Bachelor's or Master's degree in Economics, Finance, Accounting, or a related field.
• You have minimum 5 years of experience in a Financial Controller or similar finance role.
• You have solid accounting knowledge combined with strong analytical and reporting skills.
• You are experienced in budgeting, forecasting, variance analysis, and financial consolidation.
• You are familiar with annual accounts and corporate taxation.
• You have experience with Power BI and advanced Excel skills.
• You work accurately, think analytically, and easily identify financial discrepancies.
• You are proactive, well organised, and comfortable working in a dynamic environment.
• You communicate effectively and collaborate easily with both internal and external stakeholders.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English.
• You have experience with Microsoft Business Central or other ERP systems (an advantage).

We are looking for an experienced Executive Assistant to provide high-level support to the Director General. This is a key position requiring exceptional organisational skills, professionalism, discretion, and the ability to operate confidently in a fast-paced international environment.

Client Details

Our client is a well-established European association based in Brussels, representing and supporting members across Europe. Operating in an international and multicultural environment, the organisation plays a key role in fostering collaboration, advocacy, and knowledge sharing within its sector.

Description

• Act as the trusted right hand and strategic support to the Director General
• Manage a complex agenda, shifting priorities, and high-level executive commitments
• Coordinate international travel, itineraries, and meeting preparations
• Monitor and manage the Director General's inbox, correspondence, and follow-ups
• Prepare presentations, briefing documents, reports, and executive materials
• Ensure action points are tracked and deadlines are met across multiple projects
• Organise and coordinate Board Meetings, General Assemblies, and leadership meetings
• Take meeting minutes and follow up on agreed actions
• Build strong relationships with members, partners, and key stakeholders across Europe
• Liaise with internal teams to ensure smooth communication and coordination
• Handle sensitive and confidential information with the highest level of discretion
• Maintain accurate records, databases, and executive documentation
• Review expenses, approvals, and administrative processes
• Act as a key point of contact on behalf of the Director General when required
• Support the smooth functioning of the executive office and provide back-up within the administrative team
• Anticipate needs, solve problems proactively, and ensure nothing falls through the cracks
 

• 15 to 20 years of experience in a similar Executive Assistant role
• Previous experience supporting C-level or Executive-level leadership
• Experience within an international organisation, association, federation, or EU environment is highly desirable
• Outstanding written and verbal communication skills in English
• Excellent command of Microsoft Office (Word, PowerPoint, Excel, Outlook)
• Strong organisational and prioritisation skills
• Proactive, resourceful, and solution-oriented mindset
• Highly professional, trustworthy, and discreet
• Eager to learn and continuously improve

Our client plays a key role in establishing the future of renewable energy in Belgium and Europe. Join a vibrant and an international environment with a great work-life balance.

Jobomschrijving

 In this role you will report to the head of finance and will be carrying out the following tasks:

• Lead the accounting function and ensure compliant financial reporting.
• Own the month-end and year-end close process.
• Manage, coach, and develop the accounting team (2 direct reports).
• Ensure accuracy and integrity of the General Ledger.
• Lead external audits and coordinate with auditors.
• Oversee Belgian and European VAT compliance.
• Advise on accounting policies and complex transactions.
• Review reconciliations, accruals, provisions, and key journal entries.
• Improve processes, controls, and accounting procedures.
• Drive finance systems, automation, and AI initiatives.

The ideal candidate matches the following criteria:

• Bachelor's degree in accounting or equivalent 
• Minimum 7 years of experience in accounting 
• Fluent in French or Dutch and English
• Strong experience in VAT compliance and tax declarations.
• Experience with multi-country VAT registrations and compliance is a strong asset.
• Experience with Dynamics 365 is a plus
• Strong communication skills

An organisation in the industrial and manufacturing sector located in Merksem, Antwerp.

Jobomschrijving

As an AP Accountant your responsibilities are:

• Ensure supplier invoices, bank transactions, and cash allocations are processed accurately and on time every day.
• Play a key role in preparing and following up on vendor payments and managing A/P reconciliations.
• Keep international cash flows running smoothly by accurately matching payments across multiple currencies.
• Investigate discrepancies and complex accounting issues, taking ownership of finding and implementing solutions.
• Ensure quality and compliance with Belgian accounting standards, VAT regulations, and internal controls.
• Build strong partnerships with colleagues across Treasury, Accounting, TCU, and the business.
• Challenge existing ways of working and actively contribute to process improvements.
• Support the ongoing digitalization and automation of our Accounts Payable processes.

A successful AP Accountant should have:

• A Bachelor's degree in Accounting, or equivalent through relevant experience.
• At least 3 years of experience in Accounts Payable or operational accounting in an international environment, enabling you to work independently.
• Solid knowledge of invoice processing, reconciliations, payments and closing activities.
• Accurate and analytical, with the ability to investigate discrepancies and identify practical improvements.
• Hands-on, proactive and comfortable working in a high-volume and evolving environment.
• Experience with Microsoft Dynamics 365 is highly valued.
• Excellent command of English an good knowledge in Dutch.

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) - Antwerp.

Our client is an innovative organization with a long-term vision and a strong commitment to sustainable value creation. You will join a collaborative finance environment where strategy, finance and entrepreneurship come together in support of lasting growth.

The scope of responsibilities for this job as a Junior Accountant (M/V/X) include:

• You support the day-to-day accounting activities across multiple group entities and help ensure financial records are accurate, complete and up to date.
• You process invoices, bank transactions and journal entries, and contribute to the monthly, quarterly and annual closing processes.
• You assist in monitoring balance sheet accounts and help maintain a high level of financial accuracy and compliance.
• You contribute to the preparation of periodic financial reports for internal and external stakeholders.
• You support the preparation of statutory financial statements, audit documentation, reconciliations and balance sheet analyses.
• You help optimize and standardize accounting and financial processes within an evolving finance organization.
• You support the implementation of internal controls and accounting policies to strengthen the control environment and improve efficiency.
• You assist with finance-related projects, analyses and administrative tasks, and provide support to colleagues with financial questions.

The requested qualifications for this job include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in accountancy, Finance or a related field, combined with around three years of relevant professional experience.
• You have strong technical skills and an excellent command of Microsoft Excel.
• You have experience with SAP or another ERP system, which is considered a strong asset.
• You have a basic knowledge of IFRS, which is an advantage.
• You have an interest in or experience with real estate and/or private equity structures.
• You are analytical, accurate, proactive and eager to learn.
• You work well in a team and communicate smoothly with colleagues.
• You are fluent in Dutch and English, both written and spoken.

Robert Half is currently recruiting a Payment Infrastructure & Operations Expert (M/V/X) - Antwerp

Our client is an innovative and fast-growing organization active at the crossroads of technology, payments, and operations.

The scope of responsibilities for this job include:

• You ensure a stable and efficient payment operation by monitoring end-to-end payment flows and overseeing daily payment processing.
• You take ownership of the operational performance of the core banking and payments ecosystem and act as a subject matter expert for payment processes, systems, and controls.
• You investigate and resolve operational issues and complex exceptions by analyzing transaction data, reconciliations, payment statuses, and system information.
• You identify and implement structural improvements that enhance reliability, efficiency, and scalability across the payment landscape.
• You optimize, standardize, and document processes, controls, and ways of working to support operational excellence and reduce risk.
• You support business growth and change initiatives through impact assessments, testing activities, process enhancements, and system releases.
• You help maintain a controlled, resilient, and compliant operating environment by supporting internal controls, reporting, business continuity activities, and regulatory requirements

The requested qualifications for this job as Payment Infrastructure & Operations Expert (M/V/X) include:

• You hold a bachelor's or master's degree in finance, Economics, Business Engineering, Information Technology, Statistics, or a related field, or you bring equivalent experience.
• You have experience in payments, banking operations, treasury, fintech, or another transaction-driven environment.
• You have a strong affinity with payment processes, operational controls, and system-driven operations, while experience with core banking platforms, payment systems, incident management, process improvement, or testing is a strong asset.
• You combine a strong operational mindset with analytical thinking and a hands-on, structured approach.
• You enjoy solving complex operational challenges, take ownership of outcomes, and keep oversight of the full payment lifecycle.
• You stay calm and solution-oriented in environments where reliability, accuracy, and continuity are critical, even when facing incidents, exceptions, or tight deadlines.
• You continuously look for opportunities to improve processes, controls, and ways of working.
• You are a collaborative team player who builds strong relationships with internal stakeholders and external partners.

jobs.occupation: Animal Health Sales Director - Veterinary - Pharma
jobs.description:
Our client is a Belgian company specialising in the development, registration, marketing and commercialisation of veterinary pharmaceutical products for both livestock and companion animal. The organisation has built a strong reputation through its scientific expertise, in-house R&D laboratory, and regulatory excellence. Operating internationally through a network of manufacturing and distribution partners, the company offers innovative veterinary solutions across multiple continents while maintaining the agility, ownership culture, and entrepreneurial spirit of a growing SME.

Jobomschrijving

As a successful Animal Health Sales Manager - Pharmaceutical Products - Veterinary channel, you will have the following responsibilities: Business Development - Creation of new partnerships

• Identify new business opportunities and evaluate new potential products for the portfolio.
• Conduct market analysis to identify unmet needs within the Belgian veterinary sector.

• Define product positioning, pricing strategies, and go-to-market plans.

Field Sales Management

Jobomschrijving

• Customer & Account Management: Act as the main point of contact for key accounts, ensuring accurate, timely, and high-quality communication with customers and suppliers while handling orders, inquiries, and after-sales support.

• Ability to express fluently in English and mandarin/chinese

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills,

• Support the Compliance Manager in the execution and monitoring of the annual compliance plan
• Contribute to the review and implementation of AML/KYC policies, procedures and transaction monitoring processes
